premises.text: Preventable maternal complications, OBGYN shortage, rising complications, and legislation make early identification of pregnancy problems harder
premises.evidence_span: With the increasing shortage of OBGYNs, the growing rate of pregnancy complications, and new legislation negatively impacting maternal diagnostics, it's becoming more difficult to identify these problems earlier to prevent tragic outcomes

premises.text: Operator-dependent ultrasound errors cause widespread fetal malformation misdiagnosis and many mothers lack minimum-standard diagnostic ultrasound
premises.evidence_span: In the developed world, half of pregnant patients with a fetal malformation are misdiagnosed due to an error by ultrasound operators. Globally, 107 million mothers do not have access to the minimum standard diagnostic ultrasound

premises.text: Vendor-agnostic cloud AI integrates with any ultrasound machine via standard API to process exams
premises.evidence_span: Biotics AI is a vendor agnostic cloud-based solution that can integrate with any ultrasound machine over a standard API

premises.text: AI validates screening completeness and quality across many anatomical views and gives live feedback when key regions are missing
premises.evidence_span: Biotics AI has processed the entirety of Sara's ultrasound exam to validate the completeness and quality of the screening, ensuring the appropriate capture over 80 different anatomical views and structures, providing feedback to Dr. Sham if he missed any key regions

premises.text: Guided diagnostics localizes fetal malformations so abnormalities are not unnoticed and intervention can follow
premises.evidence_span: Our AI was able to localize this fetal malformation, providing feedback to the obstetrician so that way this abnormality doesn't go unnoticed and that appropriate intervention can be taken

premises.text: AI also automates reporting and documentation to save clinician time per patient
premises.evidence_span: we were able to automate reporting and documentation and save up to eight minutes per patient on documentation

premises.text: Hospitals buy via hybrid subscription plus volume-based API pricing justified by time savings, fewer callbacks, malpractice mitigation, and future NTAP reimbursement
premises.evidence_span: we're selling our solution to hospitals. We're leveraging a hybrid pricing model with a subscription-based charge for baseline subscription costs and a volume-based pricing model for API calls to our algorithms
